description: Project Mercury Team is a community of developers, innovators, and space enthusiasts turning complex NASA challenges into accessible solutions. Our project, SKYSHIFT, makes SPHEREx data easier to explore through interactive 3D visualization and intuitive tools. We bring skills in software engineering, research, and design, and welcome teammates in astronomy, AI, data science, UI/UX, and 3D development. Join us to build technology that brings space science closer to everyone!
